info.name: GrowXQ API
info.description:
Every `apps/backend` REST endpoint, grouped to match `docs/rest-api.md`. Base path `/v1` (set via `{{baseUrl}}`). Public/member routes are grouped by resource near the top; every 🛡️ admin-only route lives in the single **Admin** folder at the bottom instead, with one sub-folder per resource.

Quick start:
1. Import the companion environment file (`GrowXQ.postman_environment.json`) and select it top-right.
2. Fill in `supabaseUrl` / `supabaseAnonKey` (from your `.env`) and `testEmail` / `testPassword` (an existing Supabase user).
3. Run **Auth (Supabase) → Sign in** — it auto-saves a real JWT into `accessToken`, which every other request inherits as its Bearer token.
4. Replace the placeholder `{{...Id}}` variables with real ids as you create resources (most GET list endpoints return them).

⚠️ **Keep this collection in sync with the contract.** Whenever an endpoint is added, removed, or its request/response shape changes (see root `CLAUDE.md` → "Database schema & REST API"), update this file in the same change — see `postman/README.md`.

A member_profiles.slug — the public GET /members/:slug route keys on this.

On success, the test script below auto-saves `access_token`/`refresh_token` into this environment’s `accessToken`/`refreshToken` variables, so every other request’s inherited Bearer auth picks it up immediately — no copy/paste needed.

console.warn('Sign-in failed — accessToken was not updated.');

request.description: 🔑 Auth, any role. The path segment is the article's UUID **or** its slug — to look up by slug instead, replace `{{articleId}}` with e.g. `rbi-s-new-nbfc-framework-final-regulations-on-exemption-from-nbfc-registration` (the `slug` field from `GET /articles`). `404` (not `403`) if it’s a draft the caller can’t see.

member. Plain JSON (unlike ai-draft below — no files here). Analyzes the step-1 brief (notes/recentDevelopments/advice only — no service/country/state, those are AI-inferred later by ai-draft) and returns the minimum useful set of follow-up questions (0-10) — an empty array is a valid, expected result.

member. `multipart/form-data` — NOT JSON. The `payload` field carries the AiDraftArticleRequest shape as a JSON **string**; `files` are optional source documents (PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, or TXT — DOCX is not supported). PDF/image uploads are sent to the model as native documents; TXT is embedded as prompt text. Every uploaded file is persisted to Storage for traceability. No title/serviceIds/countries/state in the request — the model infers all four, picking services/countries only from the real active lists, and returns them in the response for the member to review/correct. Response carries `generationId` — the id of this attempt's audit row; send it back as `aiGenerationId` on POST /articles so admins can trace the saved article to these inputs (GET /admin/ai-generations/{{aiGenerationId}}).

item.name: POST /members/{{memberId}}/uploads — Request a signed upload URL

request.description: 🔒 member, owner-only (`:id` must equal caller id). Returns a signed URL — the member uploads directly to it; this endpoint never sees file bytes. `contentType` must be one of application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif (the bucket also caps uploads at 10MB); `fileName` ≤200 chars. Any file a later edit references is re-sniffed by magic bytes — `400 UPLOAD_INVALID_TYPE` / `UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE`.

🔒 member, owner-only. Creates a `pending` edit — never touches the live profile until admin approval. Shipped body is the `headline_bio` section (no proof needed). `section` can be any of: headline_bio, contact, engagements, education, work_experiences, key_clients, testimonials, awards — each has a different `payload` shape, see docs/rest-api.md / packages/shared-types/member.ts. `work_experiences`/`education` share one top-level proof (`proofFileUrl`) for the whole batch; engagements/testimonials/awards/key_clients carry proof per item instead. Any file path in a proof field must start with `{{memberId}}/` (where the upload endpoint puts them).

**To test work_experiences instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "work_experiences",
  "payload": [
    {
      "title": "Principal Consultant",
      "company": "Reyes Tax Advisory",
      "startYear": 2015,
      "endYear": null,
      "isCurrent": true,
      "description": "Lead advisor for cross-border structuring engagements."
    }
  ],
  "proofFileUrl": "{{memberId}}/work-experience-proof.pdf"
}
```

**Updated 2026-10-10.** Proof is optional everywhere. Items may carry `id` (live item id when editing) — live items now return their `proofAttachments` so you can resend them. Server rules: engagements need `clientName` (+ optional `clientEmail`, `verificationMethods` from engagement_letter|client_deliverable|mail_confirmation_pdf|newsletter_transaction_update|other, `verificationMethodOther`); key_clients max 20; work_experiences may overlap (concurrent roles; stored newest-first; only end-before-start is rejected); contact accepts `workEmail`; testimonials accept optional `clientEmail` (2026-10-21). `clientEmail` on engagements/testimonials is only returned to the owner/admin.

**To test engagements instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "engagements",
  "payload": [
    {
      "title": "Cross-border restructuring",
      "organization": "Acme Holdings",
      "clientName": "Jane Doe",
      "clientEmail": "jane@acme.example",
      "verificationMethods": ["engagement_letter", "other"],
      "verificationMethodOther": "Signed scope email",
      "year": 2024,
      "url": null,
      "proofAttachments": [{ "type": "link", "url": "https://example.com/letter.pdf", "label": "Engagement letter" }]
    }
  ]
}
```

**To test contact instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "contact",
  "payload": {
    "contactEmail": "priya@example.com",
    "workEmail": "priya@firm.example.com",
    "contactPhone": "+65 5555 0100",
    "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/priya-menon",
    "website": null
  }
}
```

**To test testimonials instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "section": "testimonials",
  "payload": [
    {
      "quote": "Clear, practical advice on our Singapore holding structure.",
      "clientName": "Jane Doe",
      "clientTitle": "CFO",
      "clientCompany": "Acme Holdings",
      "clientEmail": "jane@acme.example",
      "serviceName": "International Tax",
      "occurredOn": "2026-03-01",
      "proofAttachments": []
    }
  ]
}
``` URL fields (contact.linkedinUrl/website, engagements[].url, key_clients[].logoUrl, link-type proofAttachments, proofLink) must be http(s) — anything else is `400 URL_INVALID`.

item.name: PATCH /members/{{memberId}} — Update my availability and/or photo (live immediately)

request.description:
🔑 member, owner-only (`{{memberId}}` must be you). Any combination of `isAvailable`, `availabilityNotes` (≤200; `null`/`""` clears) and `photoUploadPath` — at least one (`400 NOTHING_TO_UPDATE`). Applies immediately, no admin review. Returns the updated `MemberDto`.

Shipped body sets availability only. For a photo: first `POST /members/{{memberId}}/uploads` with `{ fileName, contentType }`, PUT the image bytes to the returned `uploadUrl`, then send the returned `path` as `photoUploadPath` (JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤5MB — else `400 PHOTO_INVALID_TYPE` / `PHOTO_TOO_LARGE`).

**To update the photo too, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "isAvailable": true,
  "availabilityNotes": null,
  "photoUploadPath": "{{memberId}}/1761022800000-profile-photo.png"
}
```

item.name: POST /search — Ask a question (or send feedback)

request.description:
🔒 Auth, any role. Natural-language search over members, articles and events. `query` 2–500 chars (`400` otherwise); `scope` `all`|`members`|`articles`|`events`; `limit` 1–20. Response: `{ logId, answer, results, applied, degraded, ms }` — `answer` is composed from `results` only; each result may carry `relevance`, `match` and a one-line `reason` when a topic was searched. Rate limit 10/min + 100/hour per user → `429` `{ statusCode, error, message, retryAfterSeconds: 30 }` (counted per API instance). Takes several seconds (two AI calls).

To send feedback on an answer instead, replace the whole body with:
```json
{
  "action": "feedback",
  "logId": "<the logId from a previous answer>",
  "rating": 1,
  "note": "optional, max 500 chars"
}
```
`rating` is `1` or `-1`; response `{ ok: true }`; scoped to your own question; feedback has its own limit of 30/min.

item.name: POST /admin/events/import — Import events from CSV (full sync)

request.description: 🛡️ manageEvents. `.csv` only. Each row is the FULL desired state of one event (replace, not patch) and the whole file is a full sync: blank `id` → create; filled `id` matching an existing event → replace every column except `slug`; any existing event whose id is absent from the file → **deleted**. All-or-nothing — every row is validated before anything is written; one failing row means nothing is written (`400`, one `"Row N: ..."` message per failure). A file with zero data rows is rejected outright rather than deleting everything.

formdata.description: A .csv file matching the export format above — see that request’s description for the column list.

item.name: PATCH /admin/member-edits/{{memberEditId}} — Review edit (per item, or whole edit)

request.description:
🛡️ manageMembers. Shipped body is the per-item review for an array-section edit (engagements, education, work_experiences, key_clients, testimonials, awards): `items` must cover every payload index exactly once. Decisions: `approved_verified` (live WITH Verified badge; item must have proof, else 400 VERIFIED_REQUIRES_PROOF), `approved_hygiene` (live WITHOUT badge; `reason` required, shown to member), `rejected` (not applied; `reason` required). `status` is derived (verified if any item accepted) — omit it. Accepted items go live, rejected items are dropped (a live item stays as-is); decisions are stored in `itemReviews`.

**To review a headline_bio / contact edit (or approve the whole edit) instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "status": "verified"
}
```

**To reject the whole edit instead, replace the whole body with:**
```json
{
  "status": "rejected",
  "reviewNote": "Please attach a proof document for this engagement before resubmitting."
}
```
